business_idea.label: the business idea (what they want to sell or do)
business_idea.hint: Everything else in the plan depends on it.
business_idea.example: I want to sell homemade pickles

budget_inr.label: the budget (how much money they can put in, in rupees)
budget_inr.hint: So the plan only suggests things they can afford.

location.label: the location (city, town or village where they will run the business)
location.hint: Prices, customers and rules change from place to place.

skills.label: their skills (what they already know how to do well)
skills.hint: A business that uses their own skills is easier to start.

target_customers.label: the target customers (who will buy from them)
target_customers.hint: Knowing the buyers helps with price and where to sell.

en.greeting: Namaste! I will help you plan your business, one small question at a time.
en.off_topic: Good question! I will cover it in your business plan.
en.privacy: Please do not share Aadhaar, PAN, bank or phone numbers. I don't need them, and I did not save them.

questions.business_idea: What business do you want to start? (Example: "I want to sell homemade pickles")
questions.budget_inr: How much money can you put into this business? (Example: "20,000 rupees" or "1 lakh")
questions.location: Which city, town or village will you run it in? (Example: "Indore")
questions.skills: What are you good at, or what do you know how to do? (Example: "I cook tasty food")
questions.target_customers: Who will buy from you? (Example: "office workers near my area")

en.summary_title: Thank you! Here is what I know about your business:
en.summary_question: Shall I create your business plan?

hi.greeting: नमस्ते! मैं छोटे-छोटे सवाल पूछकर आपके बिज़नेस का प्लान बनाने में मदद करूँगा।
hi.off_topic: अच्छा सवाल है! इसका जवाब मैं आपके बिज़नेस प्लान में दूँगा।
hi.privacy: कृपया आधार, पैन, बैंक या फ़ोन नंबर न भेजें। इनकी ज़रूरत नहीं है, और मैंने इन्हें सेव नहीं किया।

questions.business_idea: आप कौन-सा बिज़नेस शुरू करना चाहते हैं? (जैसे: "मैं घर का बना अचार बेचना चाहता हूँ")
questions.budget_inr: आप इस बिज़नेस में कितने पैसे लगा सकते हैं? (जैसे: "20,000 रुपये" या "1 लाख")
questions.location: आप यह बिज़नेस किस शहर, कस्बे या गाँव में करेंगे? (जैसे: "इंदौर")
questions.skills: आपको कौन-सा काम अच्छे से आता है? (जैसे: "मैं स्वादिष्ट खाना बनाता हूँ")
questions.target_customers: आपसे सामान कौन खरीदेगा? (जैसे: "पास के ऑफ़िस में काम करने वाले लोग")

hi.summary_title: धन्यवाद! आपके बिज़नेस के बारे में मुझे यह पता है:
hi.summary_question: क्या मैं आपका बिज़नेस प्लान बनाऊँ?
